thesis: Mastercard qualifies deterministically as a Compounder: moat trajectory 85.25, reinvestment/FCF 83.50, management 75.00 and financial survival 84.00 clear the required gates, and all Hard Vetoes are cleared. The strongest objection is price: $565.24 is above locked Base $520.71, incentives are rising faster than network revenue, and recent buybacks were near/above Base. NORMAL is justified, but deployment stays at the dispersion-narrowed 0-2% range with macro pacing 0.5.

evidence.claim: Completed core score is 78.35 with 100% coverage; compounder conditions and all Hard Veto owner reviews pass.
Locked DCF values are Bear $291.77, Base $520.71, Bull $778.54 versus price $565.24.
FY2025 GDV +9%, cross-border +15%, switched transactions +10%, and VAS revenue +23%; Q2 2026 core and VAS growth remained positive.
Conservative owner-FCF/share proxy rose from about $11.51 in 2023 to $18.14 in 2025 while the share count declined.
Macro overlay purchase pacing is 0.5 because global Middle East energy/shipping risk is high even though US credit spreads remain tight.

counterevidence: Current price is about 8.6% above locked Base value, so there is no large initial margin of safety.
Network rebates/incentives are growing faster than payment-network net revenue, which can erode take economics.
Multiple positive domains depend on the same volume/VAS growth complex rather than fully independent evidence.
Recent buybacks averaged slightly above locked Base value, limiting capital-allocation upside.
unknowns: Long-run incentive intensity and large-contract renewal economics.
Post-acquisition ROIC for Recorded Future/security assets.
Full quarter-by-quarter normalized FP extraction for all six trailing 10-Qs.
falsifiers: MT or RF falls below the compounder thresholds, or owner-FCF/share growth fails to sustain high-single digits on a normalized multi-year basis.
Price/Base rises above 1.2 without a commensurate increase in intrinsic value.
Incentives/regulation/A2A displacement cause persistent deterioration in network economics that VAS cannot offset.
next_checks: Buyback price versus updated Base value.

plain_language.business: Mastercard는 카드 대출을 직접 해주는 회사가 아니라, 전 세계 결제의 승인·정산·보안과 관련 서비스를 연결하는 네트워크 회사입니다.
plain_language.opportunity: 결제량 증가뿐 아니라 보안·인증·데이터·송금 같은 부가서비스가 더 빠르게 성장하고 있어 장기 복리의 두 번째 축이 있습니다.
plain_language.risk: 가장 큰 위험은 회사가 망하는 것이 아니라 좋은 사업을 너무 비싼 가격에 사는 것입니다. 고객 인센티브 증가, 규제, 계좌이체형 결제망이 장기 수익성을 깎을 수 있습니다.
plain_language.decision_reason: 현재 자료에서는 컴파운더 조건과 Hard Veto 검사를 통과하지만 현재가는 Base 가치보다 높습니다. 따라서 NORMAL 판정은 유지하되 실제 신규 배치는 0~2% 범위와 거시환경 0.5배 매수속도를 적용하는 것이 하네스 규칙에 맞습니다.
